assign.request: How many of this site's audit findings are facts about the 350ms frame() delay? Dispatched by mastermind-layout.
steps: read findings.json + readme Open section, pick sample
primary sweep: 23 pages x 3 delays x 3 runs @ 1280
supplementary sweep @ 3440 for the 11 high pages
analyze: row survival, rule settle-sensitivity, node trend, cost/benefit

log.msg: Primary sweep (23 pages x 3 delays x 3 runs @1280, 207 navs, 322s) + supplementary sweep (11 high pages @3440, 99 navs, 155s): 19 of 21 pages fully stable (identical score/grade/counts/rules across all 9 runs). Only ext/LayoutTool/audit/ is settle-sensitive -- gains a cramped:high after ~1000ms that the published 350ms baseline misses (65/D->46/F @1280, 59/F->42/F @3440). All 17 of 17 high-carrying rows in findings.json survive at 3000ms.

editor-panel-review/ (readme's own worst case) is genuinely non-deterministic at every delay including 3000ms -- not climbing, jittering (nodes 3610-3754 regardless of delay). sessions/ (readme's other worst case) is now fully stable -- that example has gone stale. styles/elements/lists/ (the page named in the dispatch brief) could not be reproduced at any delay -- its page.js is mid-edit under an uncommitted diff, a live-editing confound, excluded from the tally.

assign.outcome: **17 of 17 high-carrying rows survive at 3000ms; only ext/LayoutTool/audit/ is settle-sensitive, and it under-reports (misses a high), not over-reports.** Report: public/framework/ai/2026-08-16/mastermind-layout/settle.md. Recommendation: the settle problem is real but narrow -- don't rewrite frame() for every caller, give ext/LayoutTool/audit/'s own baseline row a longer settle. Verdict on the global RULE#1 fix left to Mike.
